ownership: Vendored official Google Chromium PDFium prebuilt binaries via bblanchon/pdfium-binaries
license: BSD-3-Clause (PDFium) plus the additional bundled notices in vendor/pdfium/licenses/manifest.json; all permissive, none copyleft
privacy: Compiled third-party binary and license notices only; no personal data and no PDF content
redistribution: allowed while the complete notice directory travels with the runtime
integration_status: Not yet wired into server/. Intended to be loaded by exactly one helper process, server/pdfium-render-host.mjs, spawned as a disposable child process by server/pdfjs-subprocess.js's runSystemCommand on win32, mirroring the qlmanage system-renderer isolation already used on darwin: a hang or crash inside pdfium.dll takes down only that child process, never the long-lived worker thread serving other requests. Renders one page to an in-memory RGBA bitmap via the FPDF_* C API; PNG encoding happens in pure JavaScript, not inside pdfium.dll.

generator.runtime: Node.js standard library plus the system tar binary

build.note: PDFium is not built from source here. bblanchon/pdfium-binaries already publishes official Google Chromium PDFium builds; this script downloads, verifies against sources.lock.json, and promotes the pinned Windows release assets unmodified.

developer_gate.scope: Binds the committed runtime bytes and license notices to this provenance record and to sources.lock.json, and asserts the packager allow-lists cover the directory exactly

promotion.scope: Downloads the pinned release assets, verifies both the archive and the extracted pdfium.dll against sources.lock.json, and refuses to promote on any mismatch

notices.note: licenses/pdfium-binaries-build-scripts.txt (MIT, Benoit Blanchon) is the top-level LICENSE of the bblanchon/pdfium-binaries repository itself, covering its build scripts. It is not part of the release archive's own licenses/ directory and so is not reproduced by scripts/vendor-pdfium-runtime.mjs; it is committed alongside the release-bundled notices to attribute the build recipe as well as the binary.
